sections.heading: Added
items: Feed: filter your pet's photos by Meals, Walks, Naps, Mood, Potty or No tag, pick the pet from a dropdown, and switch between Photos and Diary. Edit a photo you posted: its tags (several), the day and time, and your note. Swipe or tap the edges to turn photos and pinch to zoom. The newest photo is shown big, a photo opens with its tag, date, time and your note, and you can hide a photo or delete it on your side only. A shared photo can be deleted for both of you for 30 minutes after it is sent. A sitter can still open the Feed of a pet after the stay, and your stickers show up in your own Feed.

Pet room: an 8-bit pet on your Home (and the sitter's) that walks around its room, eats from a bowl, naps and wakes, and shows today's care (fed, potty, mood). Put a Halloween pumpkin hat on it, or match its colors to a photo. Sitters tap Feed, Walk, Poop and Nap on it, give a medal after a stay and collect badges.

sections.heading: Added
items: Settings with What's New: open Profile → Settings to see the app version and what changed.
Photo request: an owner asks the sitter for a photo from Feed; the sitter sees a banner on Home, and their next shared photo answers it with one notice.
Split view for computers: open the demo link with ?view=split to see the owner's and the sitter's phones side by side, each signed in to its own demo account.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Treat check: a partly read or cut-off label is never called safe; allergies typed as "eggs" or "poultry" and label words like "caseinate" or "fishmeal" are caught; "peanut butter" is no longer treated as dairy.
Snap tab: Recent checks show a new check as soon as you go back.

sections.heading: Changed
items: The app is now called Goldito (was Pawddy). You will be signed out once. New photos and videos go to the goldito/ Cloudinary folder (older pawddy/ and pawnote/ media still loads). What had to be done by hand: plan/rename-goldito.ko.md.
The app is now called Pawddy (was PawNote). Demo sign-in emails are now @pawddy.test; new photos and videos go to the pawddy/ Cloudinary folder (older pawnote/ media still loads).

sections.heading: Added
items: Snap tab: Treat check reads a treat label and checks it against your pet's allergies and foods toxic to its species, with sources from trusted vet sites; Mood reads your pet's body language for fun; Sticker cuts your pet out of a photo, and stickers decorate the daily diary page.

sections.heading: Added
items: Pet Transit: a live trip map with an arrival time for drop-off and pick-up.

sections.heading: Added
items: Completion: a home-safe report, a review, and a Pet Life Record the next sitter can read.
Daily report: the AI suggests chips from the day's check-ins and photos; the sitter keeps or turns off each, adds a short note if they want, and approves before it goes out.
Inquiry: the AI drafts the sitter's reply in their own tone from the schedule, the quote and the house rules; the sitter approves it (or turns on auto-send).

sections.heading: Added
items: Care: quick check-ins (meal, potty, walk, medicine), care tasks with a photo, and a feed and album with AI captions.
Meet & Greet before a first stay, booking with consents and a demo payment, and entry info that opens only near the handoff.
